articles.summary: At this week’s American Association of Cancer Research virtual meeting, Kymera provided first disclosure of our IRAKIMiD program, which uses novel dual-function degraders for the treatment of diffuse large B cell lymphoma (DLBCL). In this post, I provide the rationale for the approach and the promising data we’re seeing in…
articles.title: IRAKIMiDs: A Single Small Molecule Approach to Developing Dual-Function Degraders for B Cell Lymphoma with Multiple Drivers
